Keep the source camera, viewing direction and body style; do not mirror or invent an unseen opposite end. Clean dirt, scratches and surrounding-scene reflections. Remove environment, people, other vehicles, road, snow and advertising/plate characters. Keep realistic glass/interior and opaque bodywork. Show the COMPLETE car, all visible tires/mirrors and original roof accessories/antenna tips in a roomy frame with useful transparent space on all sides. True RGBA transparency, no floor/contact shadow, under-car reflection, glow, background fragments, captions, watermark or checkerboard. Do not add a shark fin or antenna type absent from the source. Do not infer engine specification or precise model year.  Keep the vehicle comfortably inside the frame with clearly visible transparent margins above every roof accessory, below every tire and beyond both ends; do not enlarge it up to the edges. This exact RED Ford Focus C519 is a CHINESE-market ST-Line FIVE-DOOR HATCHBACK. Preserve this exact short-hatch body, four side doors with their own handles, original C519 ST-Line headlights, black mesh grille with Ford badge on hood edge, source sport bumper and lower corner/fog-light trim, original dark-and-silver alloy wheels, red mirrors/handles, rear hatch spoiler and any original thin antenna. Chinese 2020-2022 update kept ST-Line exterior unchanged, unlike the separately reworked ordinary sedan/wagon front; do NOT add the Chinese Shooting Brake large grille or the European 2022 grille/badge arrangement. The source photograph is dated2022-09-21 and shows the unchanged earlier ST-Line exterior; do not infer exact manufacture year from photograph date. Preserve the source near-frontal camera with only a small view of the side; do not rotate to expose an imagined rear. Preserve the dark roof panel and original wheel pattern. Whole car/visible tires/mirrors/roof hardware inside clear transparent margins; no crop, no road, no scene shadow.
